conditions: Production field_lab::fixture and Brain; temporary categorical lateral brightness cue_currents adapter and Chamber positive turn gain8 and distance coefficient .012. Brains warm60 unstimulated ticks at stationary initial pose(-2,0), heading0; then300 moving chamber ticks. Fields settle100 ticks before observation. Lamp/shade sources at(-2,-1) and(-2,+1), each radius1.5. All source scenes use background brightness .2. No-current controls clear external current each step. Both visual scenarios are compared against independently measured uniform-brightness .2 Vision controls and no-current controls. Baseline fields omit source: wind0 and source fields cannot affect the body except through disabled neural injection. Bilateral ablation begins after warmup, includes original groups even where stimulus excludes readouts. All comparisons paired by seed.
experimentalMapping: Experimental vision branch categorical lateral brightness detection: when max(L,R)>=0.05 and abs(L-R)>0.05*(L+R), inject fixed1 into greater-side pathway and0 into other side; otherwise both0. Only local sensory magnitudes are consulted. Production side identity/readout exclusion are unchanged; body decoder uses positive turn gain8 and distance coefficient .012 instead of .12.
metrics: turn/flightTurn are mean motor outputs. headingTowardSource is source-side signed net heading change; positive means yaw toward the initial source side. distanceReduction is actual initial distance minus final source distance. minimumDistanceReduction uses minimum observed distance including initial pose. earlyHeadingIntegralTowardSource integrates unwrapped yaw toward initial source side over first60ticks (6seconds); earlyAlignmentTowardSource averages actual target-facing cosine over first60ticks. All source-relative metrics consume the fixture source_position owner. finalAlignmentTowardSource is final heading dot normalized vector to source, positive means facing toward it. Difference metrics subtract the matched control. leftMinusRight uses the negative-Z source minus the positive-Z source; its spatial metrics are each oriented toward their own source.
uncertainty: Student t(29)95% intervals across paired seed means, descriptive without multiplicity correction. Free movement changes subsequent sensory histories; this is a finite closed-loop fixture, not proof of biological preference or asymptotic target seeking.
reproduction: Restore experimentalSourceSnapshots to crate files and use the old group IDs from manifestHash, then cargo run -p sim --release --example field_probe -- GRAPH_DIRECTORY OUTPUT_JSON. Original files restored afterward.
